POWER.SOLID_GREEN: Normal operation; AC power delivery optimal
POWER.FLASHING_RED: Power supply unit fault or thermal overload protection active
POWER.OFF: No power input or faulty power adapter

BROADBAND_PON.SOLID_GREEN: Optical connection synchronized to OLT; optical power optimal (-18 dBm)
BROADBAND_PON.FLASHING_GREEN: Ranging in progress; acquiring optical synchronization
BROADBAND_PON.FLASHING_RED: Loss of Signal (LOS); optical fiber disconnected, bent beyond critical radius, or external cable cut
BROADBAND_PON.SOLID_AMBER: Degraded optical signal power (-28 dBm to -32 dBm); high attenuation on line

INTERNET.SOLID_GREEN: PPPoE/IPoE WAN session active; public IPv4/IPv6 assigned
INTERNET.FLASHING_AMBER: WAN DHCP lease renewal in progress
INTERNET.SOLID_RED: WAN authentication failure or DNS resolution unreachable

WIFI.FLASHING_BLUE: WPS push-button pairing active (120-second discovery window)

activation_protocol: 1. Verify customer identity with Step-Up MFA prior to releasing eSIM SM-DP+ activation code.
2. Customer must connect device to active Wi-Fi network before initiating profile download.
3. In device Settings, navigate to Cellular / Mobile Service -> Add eSIM -> Use QR Code.
5. If download fails with error 'Profile Download Unsuccessful (EID Mismatch)', verify the device EID matches the registered EID in the Provisioning system.
